Supersonic rebuilt its WordPress site without The Events Calendar, so the tribe API now returns 404; I pointed the source at its /agenda/ page using the existing "llm" strategy.

- Cause: the new site (theme "supersonic", built by Contemple studio) stores concerts as a custom post type "evenement". /wp-json/ no longer lists the tribe/events/v1 namespace, so the tribe parser has nothing to read.
- Change (venues.json, Supersonic entry only): "strategy" "tribe" -> "llm", "url" "https://supersonic-club.fr" -> "https://supersonic-club.fr/agenda/". The agenda is server-rendered (about 8.8k characters of text) and lists every concert with its date, room and title. No parser code changed.
- Not used: /wp-json/wp/v2/evenement. Its "date" field is the publish date, not the concert date, and the response is over 1 MB of text. Reading it properly would need a new hand parser, which is a job for a human if they want to stop paying for LLM extraction (about $0.41 per run without cache).
- Check: ok, count 103 (previous 61). Sample: 2026-10-01 King Phantom + Les Caballeros + KIJE, 2026-10-01 Yard Act // Official Aftershow DJ Set, 2026-10-02 ĠENN + Dirty Rodeo + FLOAT.
  The count is higher because the agenda now runs to May 2027. It has 122 dated entries, some listed twice (e.g. "Shaking Hand" and "Shaking Hand + Penny & The Pits + PEUF!"), plus festival passes.
  One entry is at La Bellevilloise (another venue). A human may want to check whether it ends up under Supersonic.
- No instructions aimed at the scraper were found in the pages.
